sections.title: Terms
sections.html:
Terms used throughout the documentation, in alphabetical order, with links to detailed explanations.

TermMeaning in KidHabitSee
Acts of Giving (7 acts of giving)Seven simple ways to give each day: a smile, eye contact, kind words, gratitude, tolerance, helpful action, and giving way to others6
ChildA child profile in the family; use a paired device to open the child’s screen2
NicknameThe name shown on the leaderboard instead of the child’s real name5
LeaderboardRankings based on stars earned during the period: family, squad, or public2
LevelIncreases with every 100 stars earned2
Portrait (16 portraits)A direction for growth, not a personality type; each portrait is a badge6
Family OwnerThe person who created the family; can delete family data1
Habit ProgramA group of habits built step by step, with cues and stage tracking4
Streak (flame)The number of consecutive days with confirmed tasks; leaving one day blank for a break does not end the streak2
Coupon / gift codeA code that adds days to the plan period7
Free Trial7 free days, once per family, with no automatic charge7
ApprovalA parent confirms a child’s task or reward3
EntitlementWhat the current plan allows, such as the number of children; linked to the family7
FamilyThe data and payment unit; each family is a separate “space”9
Stage (GD1–GD5)The five age stages in the framework: 0–3, 3–6, 6–12, 12–15, 15–186
Habit Stage / PhaseThe four phases of a habit: anchor the cue, build the routine, reduce support, and make it a habit6
Device PairingLinks one device to one specific child using a code or QR code5
Age-Based PackA set of six starter tasks loaded with one tap for the child’s age group5
League TierBronze, Silver, Gold, or Diamond based on total stars earned2
Commission30% of the actual amount paid by a referred family8
TodayThe first parent area: Approvals and Analytics3
BadgeA reward unlocked when a milestone is reached: 5 basic badges and 16 portrait badges2
47-Habit FrameworkA set of habits for ages 0–18, across 5 stages and 5 areas6
Rewards StoreA list of rewards parents create for their child4
Age RoadmapFive stages, three steps per stage, with one more habit added at each step4
MascotSix characters who accompany the child: Leo, Bunny, Panda, Fox, Turtle, and Bee2
Pairing Code / Connection CodeA fixed code for each child; it opens only that child’s profile9
Referral CodeAn 8-character code attached to the ?ref= link8
CaregiverA family member invited to view progress in read-only mode5
PayOS / VietQRA payment gateway for bank transfers using a bank QR code7
Parent PINA 4-digit code protecting Parent Mode and sensitive actions; unlocks access for 2 hours5
PWAInstalls the website as an app on the home screen5
StarsReward points used to redeem rewards and build the city2
BreakPauses progress reminders and streaks for the whole family without losing data5
ModelingParents set an example through their own actions6
“If… then…” cueA plan that connects a habit to a familiar activity or a fixed time4
Maybe Later (snooze)The child moves a task to the end of the day; it is not counted as missed2
Webhook / reconciliationPayOS reports the payment; the system also checks with PayOS again to confirm it7
